about_the_game:
In DIGI-DOLL, a relaxing decorating simulator, Mauve, a vintage collectible doll, is freed from her box and discovers a huge dollhouse waiting to be filled with friends. Use the virtual DIGI-DOLL to explore the collector's attic, make friends, and discover furnishings and abilities!

GAMEPLAY

Explore the world through the retro DIGI-DOLL console, a clicker minigame, where the text-based choices you make determine the decor and characters you'll have in the real world. Customize your home with furniture and friends to make it truly your own!

STORY MODE

In story mode, Mauve decorates homes for other ragdolls she meets! From their descriptions and appearances, figure out the way they'd like their homes to look. Make them happy and you'll earn unique perks, like new house styles and even the ability to invite the ragdolls to your home!

FEATURES

  • retro 2bit pixel art & cute hand drawn art

  • toy nostalgia

  • figure out the unique styles of different ragdolls to get the top rating and secret unlockables! 

  • Sandbox mode - No goals or “game over”, express your creativity as you decorate your dollhouse.

  • Addicting text-based discovery 

  • Every toy can interact with the dollhouses, have fun watching them!

  • enjoy the many furniture pieces to choose from

Step into the attic, make new friends, and bring this miniature world back to life in DIGI-DOLL!
